settings.heading: Custom
settings.lead: Turn worn, carpeted or outdated stairs into a beautiful focal point. We cap each step with new treads, risers and nosing that match your floors for a clean, solid, finished look.

settings.heading: Stairs that look custom-built
settings.text: Stair capping covers your existing steps with new, durable materials — no need to rebuild the whole staircase. Every tread is measured and cut individually for a tight, precise fit, and we match the color to your new or existing floors.
settings.items:
Carpet & old material removal
Measured, custom-cut treads
Painted or matching risers
Stair nosing & landing transitions
Matched to vinyl, laminate or hardwood
Trim, caulk & clean finish
